subject.title: [Feature Request] Add option to disable 'new messages' notification banner in WebChat

question: Should WebChat add a persisted local preference for the New messages indicator, and if so must hidden mode retain a visible or keyboard-accessible manual catch-up affordance?
rationale: The existing auto-scroll modes intentionally retain the indicator as a manual recovery control, so choosing suppression semantics and the settings boundary cannot be resolved safely from implementation mechanics alone.

options.title: Add a local indicator preference
options.body: Persist a WebChat-only mode that defaults to the current indicator and offers a hidden or reduced presentation while retaining an accessible manual scroll-to-bottom action.

options.title: Keep the current affordance
options.body: Retain the New messages control without another preference because it remains the explicit recovery path for users who disable automatic scrolling.

options.title: Redesign the catch-up control first
options.body: Replace the banner with a less intrusive but still discoverable live-tail affordance before exposing any suppression setting.

recommendation.title: Add a local indicator preference
recommendation.body: Persist a WebChat-only mode that defaults to the current indicator and offers a hidden or reduced presentation while retaining an accessible manual scroll-to-bottom action.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and prior issue review connect this contributor most directly to the WebChat scroll and rendering boundary.
